:::{#exm-information-equality-fails}
#### When the support depends on the parameter

Let $X_1, \ldots, X_n \siid \text{Uniform}(0, \th)$.
The likelihood is $\Lik(\th) = \th^{-n}$ for $\th \ge \max_i x_i$
(and 0 otherwise),
so on that range $\llik(\th) = -n \log \th$
and $\score(\th) = -n/\th$.
The score is a nonzero constant,
so $\E{\score} = -n/\th \ne 0$:
@eq-score-mean-zero fails,
because the set of possible data values, $(0, \th)$, depends on $\th$.
:::
